label: D1 after a rewarded rare a1->S2 trial (late episode)
explanation: Fires only at D1 and only when the reward input is 1 (never at GO/D2, never after no reward). Its strongest and most frequent activations come right after a trial where the agent chose a1, got the rare transition to S2, and was rewarded. That pattern alone captures 80% of activation mass (dev: P 0.57, R 0.57). Restricting to ep_trial >= 30 raises precision to 0.75 because the unit is silent in the first ~20 trials of an episode and grows stronger later on. Inside this context it fires mostly when the agent goes on to repeat a1: adding the upcoming choice action == 1 gives precision 0.95 but drops mass recall to 0.60, so it was not recorded. The false positives are mostly cases where the agent switches to a2, which is the model-based response. The misses (~20% of mass, mostly weak activations) are other rewarded D1 steps, often with low model value. The predicate uses only observed variables.
